

   On the question “Shall the motion to concur be adopted?” (H.F. 2591),
the vote was:
Yeas, 35:

Alons            Bisignano        Blake            Bousselot
Campbell         Costello         Dawson           Dickey
Driscoll         Evans            Green            Gruenhagen
Guth             Klimesh          Knox             Koelker
Kraayenbrink     Lofgren          McClintock       Pike
Rozenboom        Salmon           Schultz          Shipley
Sinclair         Sires            Sweeney          Taylor
Trone Garriott   Wahls            Warme            Webster
Westrich         Whitver          Zumbach

Nays, 12:

Bennett          Donahue          Dotzler          Drey
Hardman          Petersen         Quirmbach        Staed
Townsend         Weiner           Winckler         Zimmer

Absent, 3:

Garrett          Reichman         Rowley

  The motion prevailed and the Senate concurred in the House
amendment to the Senate amendment.

   Senator Shipley moved that the bill, as amended by the Senate,
further amended by the House and concurred in by the Senate, be read
the last time now and placed upon its passage, which motion prevailed
by voice vote and the bill was read the last time.

   On the question “Shall the bill pass?” (H.F. 2591), the vote was:
Yeas, 43:

Alons            Bisignano        Blake            Bousselot
Campbell         Costello         Dawson           Dickey
Dotzler          Drey             Driscoll         Evans
Green            Gruenhagen       Guth             Hardman
Klimesh          Knox             Koelker          Kraayenbrink

Quirmbach        Rozenboom        Salmon           Schultz
Shipley          Sinclair         Sires            Sweeney

Warme            Webster          Weiner           Westrich

93rd Day                   TUESDAY, APRIL 14, 2026                           785



Nays, 4:

Bennett            Donahue            Staed              Zimmer

Absent, 3:

Garrett            Reichman           Rowley

  The bill, having received a constitutional majority, was declared to
have passed the Senate and the title, as amended, was agreed to.

                       IMMEDIATELY MESSAGED

  Senator Klimesh asked and received unanimous consent that
Senate File 2468 and House Files 2591 and 2670 be immediately
messaged to the House.

                              ADJOURNMENT

  On motion of Senator Klimesh, the Senate adjourned at 12:15 p.m.
until 9:00 a.m., Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
